composition: Pastel Riviera houses under Castel Gavone ruins on pale limestone cliffs above a pebble beach · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera faces Finale Ligure's cliffs from the sea at early afternoon, the pale limestone rock mass filling the center of the frame. The ruined towers of Castel Gavone crown the summit, pastel houses in pink and ochre cluster at the base to the right, and a pebble beach curves along the shoreline. The modelled 23 September 2026, 14:09 sun lights the cliffs brightly, the turquoise water deepening to blue beyond the rocks.
